selection: Three unseen objects from each of five volume/shape strata: top V75; compact 0.2-1 ha with zero target SCL; compact 1-5 ha with zero target SCL; elongated 0.2-5 ha with zero target SCL; and weak nonzero target SCL below 0.25.
limits: The sample is mechanism-stratified and cannot estimate population accuracy.
Top-volume selection intentionally overrepresents influential objects.
2025 support remains retrospective and cannot be used as a 2024 inference input.
Local SAR stretching is qualitative and does not define a threshold.
